description: Per-page concept-id blocks for audit-inline-links.mjs --fix. When the audit would wrap a phrase on the named page with a link to the listed concept, the candidate is suppressed. Use this for cases where the matcher's contextless heuristic produces a wrong-target / inappropriate-level / awkward-position link that human review has rejected. Each entry should carry a short comment explaining why; the audit script reads only the page→ids map.
